shouldFix.title: The cumulative G22 roster still omits the zero-linux_banner refusal required by the predecessor finding
evidence: Frozen PTCB-V43-S1's requiredRepair expressly requires distinct zero and multiple linux_banner vectors. v44 reproduces that frozen finding at the dispatched hash, so this is part of the repair bar rather than a new optional expansion.

The governing parser says: 'Zero or more than one linux_banner refuses.' Those are two different input classes. A zero-match parser can incorrectly synthesize an empty/default release while a multiple-match parser still correctly refuses.

v44's REQUIRED-each-named union contains 'multiple linux_banner refuse' but contains neither 'zero linux_banner refuse' nor an equivalent no-linux_banner vector. Exact search of the current roster confirms zero occurrences of either phrase.

honestyRepairsFromV43 itself says 'zero linux_banner is already covered only if named' and then names only multiple linux_banner. The new cumulative rule cannot recover the zero case because neither v42 nor v43's subject roster named it, and no semantic withdrawal makes it obsolete.

The other v43 omissions are repaired: absent/duplicate roots, wrong member and payload, altered capability, present wrong-length key, correctly encoded invalid signature, loaded-section acceptance, absent-IKCONFIG with valid attestation, and the full marker/header matrix are all present.
